user_decisions.decision: Drop the multi-frame send API (shout_multi/whisper_multi). A single ZeroMQ frame is bounded only by memory (ZMQ_MAXMSGSIZE default -1; zyre sets no cap), so the single-frame &[u8] API already carries arbitrarily large payloads.

proposals.spec_text: single-frame &[u8] primary API plus _multi variants; ZyreEvent multi-frame variant carrying Vec<Vec<u8>>
proposals.actual: shout_multi/whisper_multi exist on send side; parse_message reads only zmsg_first so receive is truncated to frame 0; no Vec<Vec<u8>> variant exists

proposals.rationale: Single-frame API covers all payloads _multi could send; receive can only reconstruct one frame. Removal eliminates asymmetry and fully aligns SC-004. Safe at v0.1.0 (publish=false, no external callers).
